items.title: Smart NFC keychains
items.summary: Phygital touchpoints. Tap-to-menu, tap-to-tip, tap-to-loyalty. Branded any way you like.
items.details: Used by 40+ hotels and restaurants across Italy and the Netherlands. We program the chips, you write the URL. Refresh content any time.

image.alt: 3D-printed keychains with NFC chips: venue logos, a pizza slice, pasta shapes and the Florence skyline

items.title: Branded accessories
items.summary: Table numbers, bottle tags, signage, menu holders, printed in your colours, your typeface.
items.details: Most orders ship within a week. We can match any Pantone, deboss your logo, or finish with a hand-rubbed wax for a softer touch.

image.alt: White 3D-printed menu holder with a wedding menu, on a laid wooden table

items.title: Souvenirs that sell
items.summary: Resell-quality keepsakes for hotels, venues, museums. Priced for retail margins.
items.details: Wholesale pricing kicks in at 50 units. We help with shelf packaging, hangtags, and a small reorder UI for your front desk.

image.alt: 3D-printed figurines on a dark shelf: a white gnome, a sand-coloured bull and two black cats

items.title: Employee kit
items.summary: NFC business cards, name tags, lanyards, badges. Things your team will actually use.
items.details: Carbon-fibre NFC business cards that tap a contact into a phone in one second. Personalised per person at no extra cost above 25 units.

image.alt: Two black carbon-fibre NFC business cards, one with name and contact details and one with a QR code

items.title: Retail-ready collections
items.summary: Custom themed product lines. Pasta keychains, city landmarks, food shapes.
items.details: We co-design the whole collection with you, print the first 50, and you decide whether to scale. We keep the moulds on file: reorders cost half.

image.alt: Yellow pasta-shaped keychains, ravioli, farfalle, fusilli, rigatoni and tortellini, on a chopping board

items.title: Functional parts & prototypes
items.summary: Tool holders, brackets, jigs, fixtures. Design files in by Monday, parts in your hand by Friday.
items.details: We accept STL, STEP, OBJ or .f3d. Carbon fibre and PA-CF for structural parts. We DFM-check every file and flag anything that will not survive use.

image.alt: Two cordless drills hanging on black 3D-printed mounts fixed to a concrete wall
